title: Symptom journal
privacy: Private to you. These records are excluded from family sharing and reports.
originalHint: Saved exactly as entered. Original words stay unchanged when you edit; use notes for corrections.
deleteHint: This permanently deletes the original words and all details of this entry.
empty: No entries match. Add your first entry or clear the filters.
invalid: Check the required fields, lengths and times. A resolved event needs an end time on or after its start.
invalidTime: This local time is missing, invalid, nonexistent or repeated in your timezone. Enter an unambiguous time.
filterError: Check the filter dates and text lengths.
saveError: Could not save the entry. Your input is still here; please try again.
deleteError: Could not delete the entry. Please try again.
conflict: This entry changed in another window. Cancel and reopen it to load the latest version.
timezone: Times are shown in {{timezone}}. Filters use the start date.
ownerOnly: Switch back to your own profile to use your private journal.

parser.reviewHint: Suggestions are temporary. Check every field and its original words before saving.
parser.manualHint: You can fill in every field by hand, or use the local rule-based parser. Parsing does not save a record.
parser.failed: Could not parse this text. Your input is preserved; continue by hand or try again.
parser.startRequired: Add an explicit start time before saving. An unknown start time cannot be saved yet.

zoneSource.unconfirmed: No valid saved timezone could be verified; relative times were left for confirmation.

reason.dictionary_match: Matched a supported phrase in the original words.
reason.explicit_scale: A number was explicitly written on a 0–10 scale.
reason.explicit_start: An explicit start date and time were interpreted in the saved timezone.
reason.explicit_end: An explicit end date and time were interpreted in the saved timezone.
reason.explicit_status: The original words explicitly state this event status.
reason.described_trigger: An association described by you; this is not a medical cause.
reason.described_relief: A factor you described as helping. Improvement does not mean the event ended.
reason.no_match: No supported explicit phrase was found. You can enter a value yourself.
reason.ambiguous: The original words do not determine one reliable value.
reason.multiple_candidates: Choose one symptom yourself; other details must belong to that event.

warning.unrecognized_symptom: No affirmative symptom was recognized. You can enter an unlisted symptom by hand.
warning.non_self_subject: Words about another person were excluded.
warning.hypothetical: Hypothetical or future symptoms were excluded.
warning.multiple_symptoms: Several symptoms were found. This form saves one event only. Choose one yourself and check its details; no symptom was selected automatically.
warning.ambiguous_time: A time clue needs an explicit date or clock time. It was not converted silently.
warning.duration_only: A duration was mentioned. It does not supply an end time or mean the event ended.
warning.timezone_unconfirmed: Your timezone could not be confirmed. Local and relative times need manual confirmation.
warning.nonexistent_local_time: This clock time does not exist because of a timezone clock change. Enter another explicit time.
warning.ambiguous_local_time: This clock time occurs twice because of a timezone clock change. No instant was selected.
warning.invalid_severity: The written intensity is outside the supported integer 0–10 scale.
warning.conflicting_values: Several different values were found. Confirm the correct value for this event.
warning.unsupported_expression: This wording cannot be parsed reliably. Check that it describes one event, or fill in the fields by hand. Code and links are treated only as plain text.
warning.candidate_limit: The preview limit was reached. Narrow the text to one event.

parser.leaveHint: The original text and unsaved changes will be cleared. They are not saved anywhere.
